title: Compliance, Governance & Assured Workloads — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes Regulated Compliance Architecture: Assured Workloads (FedRAMP High, HIPAA, CJIS, EU Sovereignty), Key Access Justifications (KAJ), and Personnel Access Controls (PAC).
routing_rationale: Assured Workloads enforces regulatory boundaries at the folder level through immutable organization policies, guaranteeing data residency and restricting Google personnel access.

nodes.label: Enterprise CISO / Auditor
nodes.detail: Monitors compliance posture and reviews access justification logs in real time.

nodes.label: Org Policy Guardrails
nodes.detail: Restricts resource provisioning strictly to compliant regions (e.g., us-gov-west1 or europe-west3).

nodes.label: FedRAMP High Environment
nodes.detail: Hosts government workloads with FIPS 140-2 encryption and CJIS background-checked support.

nodes.label: Key Access Justifications (KAJ)
nodes.detail: Evaluates rationale before Google Cloud support personnel can access encryption keys.

nodes.label: Personnel Access Controls (PAC)
nodes.detail: Guarantees that only vetted US citizens located in the US handle technical support.

steps.title: Regulatory Guardrail Enforcement
steps.action: Assured Workloads folder applies automated constraints blocking non-compliant regions.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates risk of human error violating sovereign residency laws.

steps.title: Support Access Justification Audit
steps.action: When support ticket is opened, KAJ demands automated justification and verifies PAC vetting.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures cloud provider personnel cannot access customer data without explicit logged consent.

scenarios.label: Deployment Blocked in Non-Compliant Region
scenarios.root_cause: Terraform script attempted to spin up GCS bucket in asia-east1 within FedRAMP folder.
scenarios.diverted_path: Resource Manager blocks API call: 'Violates constraints/gcp.resourceLocations'.
scenarios.recovery: Update Terraform configuration to target authorized region us-gov-west1.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Visualizes Regulated Compliance Architecture: Assured Workloads (FedRAMP High, HIPAA, CJIS, EU Sovereignty), Key Access Justifications (KAJ), and Personnel Access Controls (PAC).
